A story of roots and renewal

It started with my mother.

Sunita Shastri’s search for gentle, effective skincare led her back to the simple Ayurvedic rituals her mother practiced at home—and forward to formulas designed for a modern routine.

“PIYA—which means beloved—is more than a brand. It is a reflection of my roots, a tribute to my mother, and a commitment to skincare that honors Ayurvedic wisdom while embracing modern science.”

Meet PIYA
Beauty in service of something larger

Glowing skin. Greater purpose.

PIYA donates soap and supports nonprofit partners working to address hygiene poverty—because the simple dignity of clean, nourished skin should reach beyond a skincare shelf.

The essentials

Questions, considered.

What makes PIYA different?

PIYA pairs Ayurvedic inspiration and thoughtfully selected botanical ingredients with modern, science-informed formulations designed for contemporary routines.

Can PIYA soaps be used on face and body?

PIYA describes its natural soaps as suitable for both face and body. Review the directions and full ingredient list on each product page, and patch test if your skin is sensitive.

What are PIYA’s hero ingredients?

The collection highlights botanicals including turmeric, neem, saffron and tulsi, alongside modern plant-derived ingredients such as bakuchiol.

Are PIYA products vegan and cruelty-free?

PIYA states that its natural skincare is plant-based and never tested on animals. Refer to the current product page for ingredient-level details.

How should I build my PIYA ritual?

Begin with cleanse, follow with targeted renewal or radiance care, then moisturize. Choose individual products according to your skin and the directions provided on each product page.
